description: Run — one run of a workflow: when it ran, its status, and each step's status, output and error. Lumen writes it as the workflow runs, into the workflow's Runs collection; a later step reads what an earlier one returned ($.previous, $.steps.<name>).

workflow_id.description: The workflow this is a run of

steps.description: Each step: index, name, transform_id, status (pending, running, completed, failed), started_at, finished_at, output, error
